name: 回溯触发（移动）
description: 对手移动时计数；达到目标次数时，触发回溯。
code: function executeSkill(context) { if (!battle.extensions || !battle.extensions.recallData || battle.extensions.recallData.length === 0) return { success: false }; var actor = context.sourcePiece; if (!actor) return { success: false }; for (var i = battle.extensions.recallData.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { var recall = battle.extensions.recallData[i]; if (actor.ownerPlayerId === recall.ownerPlayerId) continue; recall.actionCount = (recall.actionCount || 0) + 1; var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === recall.pieceId; }); if (recall.actionCount >= recall.targetCount) { if (piece && recall.snapshot) { var occupied = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId !== piece.instanceId && p.currentHp > 0 && p.x === recall.snapshot.x && p.y === recall.snapshot.y; }); if (!occupied) { piece.x = recall.snapshot.x; piece.y = recall.snapshot.y; piece.currentHp = Math.min(recall.snapshot.hp, piece.maxHp); if (recall.snapshot.shield !== undefined) piece.shield = recall.snapshot.shield; if (recall.snapshot.statusTags) piece.statusTags = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(recall.snapshot.statusTags)); if (recall.snapshot.buffs) piece.buffs = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(recall.snapshot.buffs)); if (recall.snapshot.debuffs) piece.debuffs = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(recall.snapshot.debuffs)); } } battle.extensions.recallData.splice(i, 1); } } return { success: false }; }
